title: The Lost Pup
lines: A wild pup got lost in the cold.
A kind child and Mom went to find it.
The child held a rope and a lamp.
The pup was behind an old gate.
It was cold and it did not move.
The child told it to hold still.
Most pups run off, but this one did not.
The pup is home and it is not cold.

questions.listenFor: Behind an old gate. Stated in the story - have them go back and find it themselves.

questions.ask: What did the child bring along?
questions.listenFor: A rope and a lamp. If they get one, ask "what else?" rather than filling it in for them.

questions.ask: Do you think the child was brave? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. Listen for a reason tied to the story - going out in the cold with Mom, or holding on to a wild pup.
